exact_statement:
theorem stable_blowup (p₀ : ℕ) :
    ∃ p k : ℕ, p₀ ≤ p ∧ Odd p ∧ 3 ≤ p ∧ ∃ hk : 8 < (k : ℝ),
      ∃ U : Set FourierL2, U.Nonempty ∧ IsOpen U ∧ ∀ f ∈ U,
        IsClassicalDefocusingFlow k (by linarith) ((p - 1) / 2) f ∧
        HasFiniteTimeSelfSimilarBlowup k (by linarith) ((p - 1) / 2)
          (1 / ((p : ℝ) - 1)) f
